rules.comment: AI Granbull 376 leads at challenge 7; Smelling Salt is scored by AI_CheckViability on turn 1.
AI Zapdos 779 vs player's Cradily using Toxic every turn; covered on the turn after Zapdos's Thunder Wave (or Thunderbolt) paralyzes Cradily and Cradily still gets its Toxic off.
Player's Dusclops (Ghost, so Nidoqueen never uses Superpower) burns AI Nidoqueen 701 and Seismic Tosses it to 40% or less while Nidoqueen is faster.
Player's Granbull Intimidate uses up Nidoqueen 701's White Herb at the start; switching to Tauros (Intimidate) leaves its Attack at -1 for the AI's scoring.
AI Victreebel 395 leads at challenge 7; Sweet Scent is scored by AI_CV_EvasionDown on turn 1.
AI Minun 292 vs the player's Metang 311 (Clear Body only) at challenge 2; Charm is scored -10 on turn 1.
Player's Keen Eye Fearow Mud-Slaps AI Shuckle 528 twice; then Flash is scored with the user's accuracy stage 4 or lower.
Player's Vigoroth uses Endure every turn against AI Chansey 332's Seismic Toss; covered when Endure works on the toss that would knock it out (fails about half the time).
Player's Hitmonlee 233 uses Focus Energy twice against a harmless Marshtomp.

Player's banded Aerodactyl Hyper Beams; the AI's Exeggutor 534 Sleep Powder after it (or Slowking's Yawn on a recharge turn) leaves the recharge unspent while asleep. Depends on the AI picking the sleep move.
